transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I’ve been having these times after my late shifts where I stop and get food, and then when I get home I just keep eating. It’ll be like a full takeout meal, then chips, sweets, whatever’s around the apartment. Afterward I’m kind of shocked at how much I actually ate.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating or control how much you're eating during these episodes?

Yeah. Once I start on those nights, it feels like I can’t really stop. I’ll be telling myself to put the food away, but it’s almost like I’m watching myself do it, and my hands just keep opening containers or bags until it’s all gone.
Do you feel guilty or ashamed after these eating episodes?

I’m not really sure. I mean, I don’t feel good about it afterward, but I don’t know if I’d call it guilt or shame exactly. It’s more like… I feel frustrated with myself and kind of try not to think about it.
Have you experienced any problems with sexual interest or function?
I haven’t really noticed any problems like that. It’s not something I’ve been focused on, but nothing stands out to me.
Do you feel like you're eating really quickly during these episodes?
I’m not totally sure. I don’t really pay attention to the speed in the moment. I just know I keep eating, but I couldn’t say if it’s especially fast.
Do you think you're eating a large amount of food in a short period of time during these episodes?

Yeah, I think so. Like after a late shift, I’ll stop and get a full takeout meal, and then when I get home I’ll keep eating—chips, sweets, whatever’s around. Afterward I’m kind of shocked by how much it ended up being.
How often do these episodes of uncontrolled eating happen?

Most weeks it happens at least once, usually late at night. Since my apartment move kind of settled down, I’ve gotten into this routine where I eat way more than I planned, and then afterward I try to make up for it somehow.
Do you feel like you're in control of your eating during these episodes?
Yeah. I don’t feel in control then. Once I start on those nights, it’s like part of me is telling myself to just put the food away, but I keep opening things and eating anyway until it’s gone.
Do you feel like you're eating really quickly during these episodes?
I’m not really sure. I know I’m eating a lot, but I haven’t paid much attention to whether it’s especially fast. It’s more like I just keep going.
Do you feel like you're eating really quickly at the same time that you feel unable to stop eating during these episodes?
I’m not sure. I know I feel like I can’t stop, but I haven’t really noticed if I’m eating especially fast while it’s happening. It just feels like I keep going.
Do you think you are eating more quickly than usual during these episodes where you can't stop eating?
I honestly don’t know. I know I can’t stop once it starts, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether I’m eating faster than I normally would.
Do you feel like you're eating in secret during these episodes?
I’m not really sure I’d call it secret. I mean, I don’t usually make a point of telling anyone, but I haven’t really thought about whether I’m hiding it on purpose.
Do these episodes of uncontrolled eating cause you significant distress or interfere with your daily life?

Yeah, it does. I’m still getting to work and doing what I need to do, but it’s starting to affect things. I’ve been avoiding going out to eat with coworkers after shifts, and some mornings I’m kind of planning around making up for the night before instead of just resting or getting errands done.
Do you enjoy the food you're eating during these episodes?
I’m not really sure I’d say I enjoy it. In the moment I’m mostly just eating, kind of not thinking about it much. I haven’t really paid attention to whether it tastes good or feels enjoyable.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating a large amount of food?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve really paid attention to whether it’s guilt exactly. I know I don’t feel great afterward, but I haven’t really sorted out what that feeling is.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating a large amount of food?
I don’t know if I’d call it guilt. I know afterward I feel bad and kind of disappointed in myself, but I haven’t really put a clear label on it.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating a large amount of food?
I guess I’m still not sure I’d name it as guilt. It’s more like I feel kind of lousy about it afterward, but I haven’t really sat there thinking, “I feel guilty,” if that makes sense.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating a large amount of food?

I hear what you’re asking, but I still don’t really know if “guilty” is the right word. Afterward I usually just feel bad about it, like I’m frustrated with myself, but I haven’t really noticed guilt specifically.
Do you enjoy the taste of the food while you're eating during these episodes?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I taste it, but I don’t think I’m enjoying it in a normal way. I haven’t really paid attention to whether it tastes good during those times.
